title: PAC files across Zscaler: where each question is answered

prose.text: A PAC file is JavaScript that tells a browser, or Client Connector, where to send each request. It appears in ZIA forwarding, in Client Connector profiles and in Z-Tunnel 2.0 bypasses, and each use has its own subject.

steps.label: What PAC forwarding is, and its limits.
steps.text: Benefits, limitations, the default files and versioning: [[zia.traffic-forwarding.pac]].

steps.label: How a file is written.
steps.text: The function, return statements, Public Service Edge ports and the vendor's performance and authoring rules: [[shared.pac-files.syntax]].

steps.label: What the service substitutes.
steps.text: Gateway, host, load-balancing, country, subcloud and Client Connector variables, which work only in Zscaler-hosted files: [[shared.pac-files.variables]].

steps.label: Kerberos users.
steps.text: The Kerberos PAC file, port 8800 and the KDC proxy and realm bypasses: [[shared.pac-files.kerberos]].

steps.label: Hosting and rollout.
steps.text: The Hosted PAC Files page, Obfuscate URL, character and size limits, and how fast changes reach clients: [[shared.pac-files.hosting]].

steps.label: What it leaves uncovered.
steps.text: Non-web and non-browser applications, mobile users, and private-application destinations: [[shared.pac-files.coverage]].

prose.label: PAC files in Client Connector.
prose.text: A forwarding profile takes a PAC URL in its system proxy settings: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.internet-actions:pac-url-location]]; Tunnel with Local Proxy mode installs a PAC file that points at the local host: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.internet-actions:local-proxy-mode]]. Z-Tunnel 2.0 domain bypasses use a forwarding profile PAC and an app profile PAC: [[zcc.z-tunnel.bypasses:dual-pac]].

prose.label: Automation.
prose.text: The Terraform resource's version and status handling is [[zia.terraform.pac-files]]; how the SDKs call the clone, validate and version endpoints is [[zia.sdk-python.pac-files]].
